descriptions.text: Are you a clear-mount or photopolymer fan? If so, you'll need blocks to mount your stamps on. These high-quality acrylic blocks are grooved for easy gripping. * 1-5/8" x 1-15/16" (4.1 x 4.9 cm)

images.description: A rectangular metal cutting tool with rounded corners, displayed against a light textured background. The tool appears to be a die or template with a silver/metallic finish and clean, minimalist design.
